rag.hint: Place it in the retrieval path: preparing knowledge, finding candidates, improving their relevance, or ensuring the generated answer remains supported and traceable.

rag-01.label: A numeric vector representing semantic characteristics so related content can be compared mathematically.
rag-01.why: A numeric vector representing semantic characteristics so related content can be compared mathematically.

rag-02.label: Splits source documents into retrievable passages sized to preserve meaning without wasting context.
rag-02.why: Splits source documents into retrievable passages sized to preserve meaning without wasting context.

rag-03.label: Stores embeddings and supports efficient nearest-neighbor similarity search.
rag-03.why: Stores embeddings and supports efficient nearest-neighbor similarity search.

rag-04.label: Retrieves content by meaning rather than requiring exact keyword overlap.
rag-04.why: Retrieves content by meaning rather than requiring exact keyword overlap.

rag-05.label: Retrieves content using lexical term matches and remains useful for names, codes, and exact phrases.
rag-05.why: Retrieves content using lexical term matches and remains useful for names, codes, and exact phrases.

rag-06.label: Combines semantic and keyword retrieval to benefit from meaning and exact-term matching.
rag-06.why: Combines semantic and keyword retrieval to benefit from meaning and exact-term matching.

rag-07.label: Restricts retrieval by attributes such as tenant, date, document type, or access level.
rag-07.why: Restricts retrieval by attributes such as tenant, date, document type, or access level.

rag-08.label: Re-scores retrieved candidates to place the passages most relevant to the full query first.
rag-08.why: Re-scores retrieved candidates to place the passages most relevant to the full query first.

rag-09.label: Constrains generation to supplied evidence so claims can be supported and traced.
rag-09.why: Constrains generation to supplied evidence so claims can be supported and traced.

rag-10.label: Links an answer claim back to the source passage that supports it.
rag-10.why: Links an answer claim back to the source passage that supports it.

rag-11.label: Indicates whether the retrieval stage finds the evidence needed to answer a question.
rag-11.why: If 100 questions require a known evidence passage and the retriever returns it for 85, retrieval recall is 85%. Low retrieval recall points to chunking, embeddings, filters, query rewriting, or candidate-count problems that generation cannot repair.

rag-12.label: Indicates how much of the retrieved context is relevant rather than distracting noise.
rag-12.why: Indicates how much of the retrieved context is relevant rather than distracting noise.
